     │ | apps/api/application/workflow_service.py     | Call TraceabilityService after artifact storage |│
     │ | apps/api/routes/workflows.py                 | Add GET /{workflow_id}/traceability endpoint    |│
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Files to Create                                                                                   │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ | File                                             | Purpose                                |     │
     │ |--------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|     │
     │ | apps/api/tests/unit/test_traceability_service.py | Unit tests for traceability extraction |     │
     │ | tools/verify_traces.py                           | Gate B verification script             |     │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Implementation Phases                                                                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Phase 1: TraceabilityService (traceability_service.py)                                            │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ from typing import Any                                                                            │
     │ from uuid import UUID                                                                             │
     │ from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession                                                   │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ from domain.state import StepName, STEP_NUMBERS                                                   │
     │ from infrastructure.db.models import TraceabilityLink                                             │
     │ from infrastructure.db.repositories import TraceabilityLinkRepository                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ class TraceabilityService:                                                                        │
     │     """Extract and persist traceability links from step packages."""                              │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:                                            │
     │         self._session = session                                                                   │
     │         self._trace_repo = TraceabilityLinkRepository(session)                                    │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     async def extract_and_persist_links(                                                          │
     │         self,                                                                                     │
     │         workflow_id: UUID,                                                                        │
     │         step_name: StepName,                                                                      │
     │         package_content: dict[str, Any],                                                          │
     │     ) -> list[TraceabilityLink]:                                                                  │
     │         """Extract trace links from package and persist idempotently.                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         Args:                                                                                     │
     │             workflow_id: Database workflow UUID.                                                  │
     │             step_name: Step name (REQUIREMENTS or OBJECTIVES).                                    │
     │             package_content: Full package dict with metadata.                                     │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         Returns:                                                                                  │
     │             List of created TraceabilityLink records.                                             │
     │         """                                                                                       │
     │         step_number = STEP_NUMBERS[step_name]                                                     │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         # Step 1 has no forward links (it's the source)                                           │
     │         if step_name == StepName.PROBLEM_DEFINITION:                                              │
     │             return []                                                                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         links = []                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         if step_name == StepName.REQUIREMENTS:                                                    │
     │             links = self._extract_step2_links(step_number, package_content)                       │
     │         elif step_name == StepName.OBJECTIVES:                                                    │
     │             links = self._extract_step3_links(step_number, package_content)                       │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         # Persist idempotently                                                                    │
     │         created = []                                                                              │
     │         for link_data in links:                                                                   │
     │             existing = await self._trace_repo.find_by_unique(                                     │
     │                 workflow_id=workflow_id,                                                          │
     │                 from_id=link_data["from_id"],                                                     │
     │                 to_id=link_data["to_id"],                                                         │
     │                 link_type=link_data["link_type"],                                                 │
     │             )                                                                                     │
     │             if existing:                                                                          │
     │                 continue                                                                          │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             link = TraceabilityLink(                                                              │
     │                 workflow_id=workflow_id,                                                          │
     │                 from_step=link_data["from_step"],                                                 │
     │                 from_type=link_data["from_type"],                                                 │
     │                 from_id=link_data["from_id"],                                                     │
     │                 to_step=link_data["to_step"],                                                     │
     │                 to_type=link_data["to_type"],                                                     │
     │                 to_id=link_data["to_id"],                                                         │
     │                 link_type=link_data["link_type"],                                                 │
     │                 consolidated=link_data.get("consolidated", False),                                │
     │             )                                                                                     │
     │             self._session.add(link)                                                               │
     │             created.append(link)                                                                  │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         if created:                                                                               │
     │             await self._session.flush()                                                           │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         return created                                                                            │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     def _extract_step2_links(                                                                     │
     │         self,                                                                                     │
     │         step_number: int,                                                                         │
     │         package: dict[str, Any],                                                                  │
     │     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:                                                                    │
     │         """Extract Step 1 → Step 2 links from RequirementsPackage."""                             │
     │         links = []                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         for req in package.get("requirements", []):                                               │
     │             req_id = req.get("id")                                                                │
     │             if not req_id:                                                                        │
     │                 continue                                                                          │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             req_type = self._get_type_from_id(req_id)                                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             # source.id → primary derivation                                                      │
     │             source = req.get("source", {})                                                        │
     │             if source.get("id"):                                                                  │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 1,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": source.get("type", "unknown"),                                   │
     │                     "from_id": source["id"],                                                      │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": req_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": req_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "derives",                                                       │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             # trace object → additional links                                                     │
     │             trace = req.get("trace", {})                                                          │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             for sh_id in trace.get("stakeholders", []):                                           │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 1,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": "stakeholder",                                                   │
     │                     "from_id": sh_id,                                                             │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": req_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": req_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "traces_to",                                                     │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             for const_id in trace.get("constraints", []):                                         │
     │                 const_type = "hard_constraint" if const_id.startswith("HC-") else                 │
     │ "soft_constraint"                                                                                 │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 1,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": const_type,                                                      │
     │                     "from_id": const_id,                                                          │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": req_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": req_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "traces_to",                                                     │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             for scope_id in trace.get("scope_in", []):                                            │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 1,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": "scope_in",                                                      │
     │                     "from_id": scope_id,                                                          │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": req_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": req_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "traces_to",                                                     │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             for crt_id in trace.get("success_criteria", []):                                      │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 1,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": "success_criterion",                                             │
     │                     "from_id": crt_id,                                                            │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": req_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": req_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "traces_to",                                                     │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             for ip_id in trace.get("integration_points", []):                                     │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 1,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": "integration_point",                                             │
     │                     "from_id": ip_id,                                                             │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": req_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": req_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "traces_to",                                                     │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         return links                                                                              │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     def _extract_step3_links(                                                                     │
     │         self,                                                                                     │
     │         step_number: int,                                                                         │
     │         package: dict[str, Any],                                                                  │
     │     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:                                                                    │
     │         """Extract Step 2 → Step 3 links from ObjectivesPackage."""                               │
     │         links = []                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         for obj in package.get("objectives", []):                                                 │
     │             obj_id = obj.get("id")                                                                │
     │             if not obj_id:                                                                        │
     │                 continue                                                                          │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             obj_type = self._get_type_from_id(obj_id)                                             │
     │             consolidated = obj.get("consolidated", False)                                         │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             # linked_requirements → primary derivation                                            │
     │             for req_id in obj.get("linked_requirements", []):                                     │
     │                 req_type = self._get_type_from_id(req_id)                                         │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 2,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": req_type,                                                        │
     │                     "from_id": req_id,                                                            │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": obj_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": obj_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "achieves",                                                      │
     │                     "consolidated": consolidated,                                                 │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             # acceptance_criteria → link back to Step 1                                           │
     │             for crt_id in obj.get("acceptance_criteria", []):                                     │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 1,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": "success_criterion",                                             │
     │                     "from_id": crt_id,                                                            │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": obj_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": obj_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "traces_to",                                                     │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         # trace_map entries (may duplicate linked_requirements, idempotency handles this)         │
     │         for trace in package.get("trace_map", []):                                                │
     │             obj_id = trace.get("objective_id")                                                    │
     │             if not obj_id:                                                                        │
     │                 continue                                                                          │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             obj_type = self._get_type_from_id(obj_id)                                             │
     │             consolidated = trace.get("consolidated", False)                                       │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │             for req_id in trace.get("requirement_ids", []):                                       │
     │                 req_type = self._get_type_from_id(req_id)                                         │
     │                 links.append({                                                                    │
     │                     "from_step": 2,                                                               │
     │                     "from_type": req_type,                                                        │
     │                     "from_id": req_id,                                                            │
     │                     "to_step": step_number,                                                       │
     │                     "to_type": obj_type,                                                          │
     │                     "to_id": obj_id,                                                              │
     │                     "link_type": "achieves",                                                      │
     │                     "consolidated": consolidated,                                                 │
     │                 })                                                                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         return links                                                                              │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     def _get_type_from_id(self, element_id: str) -> str:                                          │
     │         """Infer element type from ID prefix."""                                                  │
     │         if not element_id or "-" not in element_id:                                               │
     │             return "unknown"                                                                      │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         prefix = element_id.split("-")[0]                                                         │
     │         type_map = {                                                                              │
     │             "SH": "stakeholder",                                                                  │
     │             "HC": "hard_constraint",                                                              │
     │             "SC": "soft_constraint",                                                              │
     │             "IN": "scope_in",                                                                     │
     │             "OUT": "scope_out",                                                                   │
     │             "CRT": "success_criterion",                                                           │
     │             "ASM": "assumption",                                                                  │
     │             "OQ": "open_question",                                                                │
     │             "IP": "integration_point",                                                            │
     │             "FR": "functional_requirement",                                                       │
     │             "NFR": "non_functional_requirement",                                                  │
     │             "CR": "constraint_requirement",                                                       │
     │             "IR": "interface_requirement",                                                        │
     │             "CAP": "capability_objective",                                                        │
     │             "QUAL": "quality_objective",                                                          │
     │             "COMP": "compliance_objective",                                                       │
     │             "INTF": "interface_objective",                                                        │
     │         }                                                                                         │
     │         return type_map.get(prefix, "unknown")                                                    │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     async def get_forward_traces(                                                                 │
     │         self,                                                                                     │
     │         workflow_id: UUID,                                                                        │
     │         from_id: str,                                                                             │
     │     ) -> list[TraceabilityLink]:                                                                  │
     │         """Get all links originating from an element."""                                          │
     │         return await self._trace_repo.list_from_element(workflow_id, from_id)                     │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     async def get_backward_traces(                                                                │
     │         self,                                                                                     │
     │         workflow_id: UUID,                                                                        │
     │         to_id: str,                                                                               │
     │     ) -> list[TraceabilityLink]:                                                                  │
     │         """Get all links pointing to an element."""                                               │
     │         return await self._trace_repo.list_to_element(workflow_id, to_id)                         │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     async def list_all_links(                                                                     │
     │         self,                                                                                     │
     │         workflow_id: UUID,                                                                        │
     │     ) -> list[TraceabilityLink]:                                                                  │
     │         """Get all traceability links for a workflow."""                                          │
     │         return await self._trace_repo.list_for_workflow(workflow_id)                              │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     async def verify_coverage(                                                                    │
     │         self,                                                                                     │
     │         workflow_id: UUID,                                                                        │
     │     ) -> dict[str, Any]:                                                                          │
     │         """Verify traceability coverage across steps.                                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         Returns dict with coverage statistics and any gaps.                                       │
     │         """                                                                                       │
     │         links = await self._trace_repo.list_for_workflow(workflow_id)                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         # Group by step transitions                                                               │
     │         step1_to_step2 = [l for l in links if l.from_step == 1 and l.to_step == 2]                │
     │         step2_to_step3 = [l for l in links if l.from_step == 2 and l.to_step == 3]                │
     │         step1_to_step3 = [l for l in links if l.from_step == 1 and l.to_step == 3]                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         return {                                                                                  │
     │             "total_links": len(links),                                                            │
     │             "step1_to_step2": len(step1_to_step2),                                                │
     │             "step2_to_step3": len(step2_to_step3),                                                │
     │             "step1_to_step3": len(step1_to_step3),                                                │
     │             "has_step1_coverage": len(step1_to_step2) > 0,                                        │
     │             "has_step2_coverage": len(step2_to_step3) > 0,                                        │
     │             "valid": len(step1_to_step2) > 0 and len(step2_to_step3) > 0,                         │
     │         }                                                                                         │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Phase 2: Workflow Service Integration                                                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Modify sync_artifacts_from_state() to call TraceabilityService after storing packages:            │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ # At top of workflow_service.py, add import:                                                      │
     │ from application.traceability_service import TraceabilityService                                  │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ # In __init__, add:                                                                               │
     │ self._traceability_service = TraceabilityService(session)                                         │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ # In sync_artifacts_from_state(), after storing step package:                                     │
     │ if step_exec and step_exec.status == StepStatus.APPROVED:                                         │
     │     # Store package                                                                               │
     │     artifact = await self._artifact_service.store_step_package(...)                               │
     │     result[(PassType.EXECUTION, step_key)] = artifact.id                                          │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     # P5.4: Extract and persist traceability links                                                │
     │     try:                                                                                          │
     │         await self._traceability_service.extract_and_persist_links(                               │
     │             workflow_id=workflow_db_id,                                                           │
     │             step_name=step_name,                                                                  │
     │             package_content=artifact.content_jsonb,  # Use stored package with metadata           │
     │         )                                                                                         │
     │         logger.info(f"Extracted traceability links for {step_key}")                               │
     │     except Exception as e:                                                                        │
     │         logger.error(f"Failed to extract trace links for {step_key}: {e}")                        │
     │         # Continue - trace extraction failure shouldn't block artifact storage                    │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Phase 3: API Endpoint (routes/workflows.py)                                                       │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Add the traceability endpoint:                                                                    │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ from application.traceability_service import TraceabilityService                                  │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ @router.get("/{workflow_id}/traceability")                                                        │
     │ async def get_traceability(                                                                       │
     │     workflow_id: str,                                                                             │
     │     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session),                                                 │
     │ ):                                                                                                │
     │     """Get traceability links across steps."""                                                    │
     │     # Resolve workflow                                                                            │
     │     workflow_repo = WorkflowRepository(session)                                                   │
     │     workflow = await workflow_repo.get_by_external_id(workflow_id)                                │
     │     if not workflow:                                                                              │
     │         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Workflow not found: {workflow_id}")         │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     # Get all links                                                                               │
     │     traceability_service = TraceabilityService(session)                                           │
     │     links = await traceability_service.list_all_links(workflow.id)                                │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     # Get coverage verification                                                                   │
     │     coverage = await traceability_service.verify_coverage(workflow.id)                            │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     return {                                                                                      │
     │         "workflow_id": workflow_id,                                                               │
     │         "links": [                                                                                │
     │             {                                                                                     │
     │                 "id": str(link.id),                                                               │
     │                 "from_step": link.from_step,                                                      │
     │                 "from_type": link.from_type,                                                      │
     │                 "from_id": link.from_id,                                                          │
     │                 "to_step": link.to_step,                                                          │
     │                 "to_type": link.to_type,                                                          │
     │                 "to_id": link.to_id,                                                              │
     │                 "link_type": link.link_type,                                                      │
     │                 "consolidated": link.consolidated,                                                │
     │             }                                                                                     │
     │             for link in links                                                                     │
     │         ],                                                                                        │
     │         "coverage": coverage,                                                                     │
     │     }                                                                                             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Phase 4: Verification Tool (tools/verify_traces.py)                                               │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ #!/usr/bin/env python3                                                                            │
     │ """                                                                                               │
     │ Gate B Verification: Traceability Links                                                           │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ Usage: python tools/verify_traces.py --workflow <workflow_id>                                     │
     │ """                                                                                               │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ import argparse                                                                                   │
     │ import asyncio                                                                                    │
     │ import sys                                                                                        │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ from sqlalchemy import select, func                                                               │
     │ from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession                              │
     │ from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker                                                           │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ from infrastructure.db.models import Artifact, TraceabilityLink                                   │
     │ from infrastructure.db.models.enums import PassType                                               │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ async def verify_traces(workflow_id: str, database_url: str) -> bool:                             │
     │     """Verify traceability links exist for a workflow."""                                         │
     │     engine = create_async_engine(database_url)                                                    │
     │     async_session = sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)             │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     async with async_session() as session:                                                        │
     │         # Get workflow UUID from external ID                                                      │
     │         from infrastructure.db.models import Workflow                                             │
     │         stmt = select(Workflow).where(Workflow.workflow_id == workflow_id)                        │
     │         result = await session.execute(stmt)                                                      │
     │         workflow = result.scalar_one_or_none()                                                    │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         if not workflow:                                                                          │
     │             print(f"ERROR: Workflow not found: {workflow_id}")                                    │
     │             return False                                                                          │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         # Count trace links by step transition                                                    │
     │         stmt = (                                                                                  │
     │             select(                                                                               │
     │                 TraceabilityLink.from_step,                                                       │
     │                 TraceabilityLink.to_step,                                                         │
     │                 func.count(TraceabilityLink.id).label("count"),                                   │
     │             )                                                                                     │
     │             .where(TraceabilityLink.workflow_id == workflow.id)                                   │
     │             .group_by(TraceabilityLink.from_step, TraceabilityLink.to_step)                       │
     │         )                                                                                         │
     │         result = await session.execute(stmt)                                                      │
     │         counts = {(row.from_step, row.to_step): row.count for row in result}                      │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         print(f"Workflow: {workflow_id}")                                                         │
     │         print(f"Step 1 → Step 2 links: {counts.get((1, 2), 0)}")                                  │
     │         print(f"Step 2 → Step 3 links: {counts.get((2, 3), 0)}")                                  │
     │         print(f"Step 1 → Step 3 links: {counts.get((1, 3), 0)}")                                  │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         # Gate B requirement: Step 2 and 3 must have incoming traces                              │
     │         step2_has_traces = counts.get((1, 2), 0) > 0                                              │
     │         step3_has_traces = counts.get((2, 3), 0) > 0                                              │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │         if step2_has_traces and step3_has_traces:                                                 │
     │             print("✓ Gate B: Traceability links valid")                                           │
     │             return True                                                                           │
     │         else:                                                                                     │
     │             print("✗ Gate B: Missing traceability links")                                         │
     │             if not step2_has_traces:                                                              │
     │                 print("  - Step 2 missing traces from Step 1")                                    │
     │             if not step3_has_traces:                                                              │
     │                 print("  - Step 3 missing traces from Step 2")                                    │
     │             return False                                                                          │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │ def main():                                                                                       │
     │     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Verify traceability links (Gate B)")            │
     │     parser.add_argument("--workflow", required=True, help="Workflow ID to verify")                │
     │     parser.add_argument("--database-url", default=None, help="Database URL (or use DATABASE_URL   │
     │ env)")                                                                                            │
     │     args = parser.parse_args()                                                                    │
     │                                                                                                   │
     │     import os                                                                                     │
     │     database_url = args.database_url or os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL")                            │
     │     if not database_url:                                                                          │
     │         print("ERROR: DATABASE_URL not set")                                                      │
     │         sys.exit(1)                                                                               │
     │                                                                                                   │

     │     sys.exit(0 if success else 1)                                                                 │

<Co-Developer-1>
Assessment: mostly aligned with P5.4 intent (persist traceability_links from
  Step 2/3 packages, integrate after artifact storage). But there are several
  mismatches vs the earlier directives and Doc 2/Doc 3 semantics that I
  recommend correcting before implementation.

  Key gaps vs directives/spec

  - Revision safety: insert-only idempotency leaves stale links after package
    revisions. Traceability needs to reflect the latest approved package; use
    replace/diff per step (delete existing links for workflow_id + to_step, then
    insert computed set).
  - Step1→3 links: extracting acceptance_criteria as Step1→3 traces_to violates
    the “Step 1→2→3 chain only” directive and Doc 2 §6.1 chain. Unless
    explicitly allowed, skip cross-step links.
  - Source of truth: Step 2 extraction should use coverage_map as the primary
    mapping (Doc 3 §5.2). The proposed _extract_step2_links never reads
    coverage_map, so it’s incomplete.
  - Type semantics: mapping IDs to functional_requirement, capability_objective,
    etc. isn’t in Doc 3’s traceability model. Keep canonical types (stakeholder,
    constraint, scope, success_criterion, integration_point, requirement,
    objective) and avoid inserting “unknown.”
  - Scope creep: tools/verify_traces.py is a P6.2 deliverable (Gate B test);
    adding it in P5.4 breaks the slice boundary. The /traceability endpoint can
    be deferred unless explicitly requested.
  - Error handling: “continue on extraction failure” hides Gate B violations.
    Prefer failing the sync (or at least surfacing a validation error) so
    missing traces are visible.

  Best path to achieve objective (recommended changes)

  - Extract links only from coverage_map (Step1→2) and trace_map (Step2→3);
    optionally fall back to requirements.source only when coverage_map is
    missing.
  - Use only link_type="derives" for Step1→2 and link_type="achieves" for
    Step2→3; avoid extra traces_to unless the spec explicitly requires it.
  - Implement replace/diff logic per step to keep links aligned with the latest
    approved revision.
  - Keep from_type/to_type canonical (e.g., requirement, objective, stakeholder,
    constraint, scope, success_criterion, integration_point), not category-
    specific strings.
  - Defer tools/verify_traces.py to P6.2 and make /traceability optional for
    this slice.

⏺ My Analysis of Co-Developer-1's Feedback

  I've carefully evaluated each point against the spec and my plan. Here's my assessment:

  1. Revision Safety (Replace/Diff vs Insert-Only)

  Co-Developer-1: Use replace semantics - delete existing links for (workflow_id, to_step), then insert new set.

  My Assessment: AGREE

  My idempotent insert approach handles duplicate prevention but fails when a package is revised. If a user modifies Step 2 (removes a requirement), the old trace links remain as orphans. Replace semantics correctly reflect the current approved state.

  # Better approach:
  async def extract_and_persist_links(...):
      # Delete existing links TO this step
      await self._trace_repo.delete_for_step(workflow_id, to_step=step_number)
      # Insert fresh links from current package
      ...

  ---
  2. Step 1→3 Links (acceptance_criteria)

  Co-Developer-1: Skip cross-step links; follow "Step 1→2→3 chain only" directive.

  My Assessment: AGREE

  Doc 2 §6.1 defines the traceability chain as Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3. While acceptance_criteria semantically links objectives to success criteria, storing this in traceability_links violates the chain model. The data exists in the package JSON and can be queried there if needed.

  Remove: Extraction of objectives[i].acceptance_criteria[] → traceability_links

  ---
  3. Source of Truth: coverage_map for Step 2

  Co-Developer-1: Use coverage_map as primary source per Doc 3 §5.2.

  My Assessment: AGREE

  Looking at the schema:
  coverage_map:
    - source_type: stakeholder
      source_id: SH-001
      requirement_ids: [FR-001, FR-002]
      coverage_note: "Full coverage"

  This is explicitly labeled "Step 1 → Step 2 traceability coverage" in the schema. It's the consolidated, authoritative view. My plan extracted from requirements[i].source and requirements[i].trace, which is more granular but not the intended trace source.

  Change: Extract Step 1→2 links from coverage_map[], not from individual requirement fields.

  ---
  4. Type Semantics (Canonical Types)

  Co-Developer-1: Keep canonical types (stakeholder, requirement, objective, constraint), not category-specific strings.

  My Assessment: AGREE

  Doc 3 examples show:
  from_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,  -- 'stakeholder', 'requirement', etc.

  My plan used functional_requirement, capability_objective, hard_constraint, etc. - overly specific and not in the spec.

  Canonical types:
  | Element                | Type              |
  |------------------------|-------------------|
  | SH-xxx                 | stakeholder       |
  | HC-xxx, SC-xxx         | constraint        |
  | IN-xxx, OUT-xxx        | scope             |
  | CRT-xxx                | success_criterion |
  | IP-xxx                 | integration_point |
  | FR/NFR/CR/IR-xxx       | requirement       |
  | CAP/QUAL/COMP/INTF-xxx | objective         |

  ---
  5. Scope Creep: verify_traces.py

  Co-Developer-1: Defer to P6.2 (Gate B test slice).

  My Assessment: AGREE

  Doc 0 clearly defines:
  - P5.4: "Links populated" (data exists)
  - P6.2: "Gate B test" (verification tooling)

  Including verify_traces.py in P5.4 crosses the slice boundary. The exit criterion for P5.4 is that links exist in the database, not that there's a verification tool.

  Remove: tools/verify_traces.py from P5.4 scope.

  ---
  6. /traceability Endpoint

  Co-Developer-1: Can be deferred.

  My Assessment: OPTIONAL - DEFER

  Doc 3 §9.3 associates this endpoint with Gate B. Since the endpoint is primarily for querying/verification (not persistence), it fits better in P6 with the other verification work. P5.4 focus should be on the extraction and persistence logic.

  Defer: GET /workflows/{id}/traceability to P6.

  ---
  7. Error Handling

  Co-Developer-1: Prefer failing sync over silent continuation.

  My Assessment: AGREE

  My "continue on failure" approach was pragmatic but masks Gate B violations. If trace extraction fails:
  - It likely indicates a bug or malformed package
  - Gate B will silently fail later
  - Better to surface the error early

  Change: Let extraction errors propagate up (or wrap in a clear validation error).

  ---
  Revised P5.4 Approach

  | Aspect                 | Original Plan                                | Revised Plan                             |
  |------------------------|----------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
  | Idempotency            | Insert-only with duplicate check             | Replace: delete + insert per step        |
  | Step 1→3 links         | Include acceptance_criteria                  | Skip - chain directive                   |
  | Step 1→2 source        | requirements[].source + trace                | coverage_map[]                           |
  | Step 2→3 source        | objectives[].linked_requirements + trace_map | trace_map[]                              |
  | from_type/to_type      | Category-specific                            | Canonical (requirement, objective, etc.) |
  | verify_traces.py       | Include                                      | Defer to P6.2                            |
  | /traceability endpoint | Include                                      | Defer to P6                              |
  | Error handling         | Continue on failure                          | Fail sync                                |

  Link types (simplified):
  - derives: Step 1 → Step 2 (from coverage_map)
  - achieves: Step 2 → Step 3 (from trace_map)

  I recommend proceeding with these revisions to the plan. Shall I update the plan file?

     P5.4 Implementation Plan: Traceability Links (Revised)

     Overview

     Extract and persist traceability links from approved Step 2 and Step 3 packages into the 
     traceability_links table. Links follow the strict Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3 chain per Doc 2 §6.1.

     Gate Addressed:
     - Gate B: Packages validate + trace links work

     Exit Criterion: Links populated in traceability_links table for Step 2 and Step 3 packages.

     ---
     Current State (P5.3 Complete)

     - ArtifactService.store_step_package() stores Pass 2 packages with content in content_jsonb
     - WorkflowService.sync_artifacts_from_state() persists artifacts for APPROVED steps
     - TraceabilityLink model and TraceabilityLinkRepository exist but unused
     - TraceabilityService is a stub (comments only)

     ---
     Traceability Chain (Doc 2 §6.1)

     Step 1 (Problem Definition)
         ↓ derives
     Step 2 (Requirements)
         ↓ achieves
     Step 3 (Objectives)

     Source → Target Mapping:

     | From Step | To Step | Source Field   | Link Type |
     |-----------|---------|----------------|-----------|
     | 1         | 2       | coverage_map[] | derives   |
     | 2         | 3       | trace_map[]    | achieves  |

     Canonical Element Types:

     | ID Pattern                            | Canonical Type    |
     |---------------------------------------|-------------------|
     | SH-xxx                                | stakeholder       |
     | HC-xxx, SC-xxx                        | constraint        |
     | IN-xxx, OUT-xxx                       | scope             |
     | CRT-xxx                               | success_criterion |
     | IP-xxx                                | integration_point |
     | ASM-xxx                               | assumption        |
     | FR-xxx, NFR-xxx, CR-xxx, IR-xxx       | requirement       |
     | CAP-xxx, QUAL-xxx, COMP-xxx, INTF-xxx | objective         |

     Files to Modify

     artifact storage |

                |

     Files to Create

     | apps/api/tests/unit/test_traceability_service.py | Unit tests for traceability extraction |

     ---
     Implementation Phases

     Phase 1: Add Repository Method

     Add delete_for_step() to TraceabilityLinkRepository:

     # apps/api/infrastructure/db/repositories/traceability.py

     async def delete_for_step(
         self,
         workflow_id: UUID,
         to_step: int,
     ) -> int:
         """Delete all links targeting a specific step.

         Used for replace semantics: delete old links before inserting new ones
         from the latest approved package revision.

         Args:
             workflow_id: Workflow UUID
             to_step: Target step number (2 or 3)

         Returns:
             Number of deleted rows
         """
         from sqlalchemy import delete

         stmt = delete(TraceabilityLink).where(
             TraceabilityLink.workflow_id == workflow_id,
             TraceabilityLink.to_step == to_step,
         )
         result = await self._session.execute(stmt)
         return result.rowcount

     Phase 2: TraceabilityService (traceability_service.py)

     """
     SOLVER API - Traceability Service

     Extracts and persists traceability links from step packages per Doc 2 §6.1.
     Chain: Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3 (no cross-step links).
     """

     import logging
     from typing import Any
     from uuid import UUID

     from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

     from domain.state import StepName, STEP_NUMBERS
     from infrastructure.db.models import TraceabilityLink
     from infrastructure.db.repositories import TraceabilityLinkRepository


     logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


     class TraceabilityExtractionError(Exception):
         """Error extracting traceability links from package."""
         pass


     class TraceabilityService:
         """Extract and persist traceability links from step packages.

         Uses replace semantics: on each extraction, delete existing links
         for the target step, then insert fresh links from the current package.
         This ensures links always reflect the latest approved revision.
         """

         # Canonical type mapping from ID prefix
         TYPE_MAP = {
             "SH": "stakeholder",
             "HC": "constraint",
             "SC": "constraint",
             "IN": "scope",
             "OUT": "scope",
             "CRT": "success_criterion",
             "ASM": "assumption",
             "OQ": "open_question",
             "IP": "integration_point",
             "FR": "requirement",
             "NFR": "requirement",
             "CR": "requirement",
             "IR": "requirement",
             "CAP": "objective",
             "QUAL": "objective",
             "COMP": "objective",
             "INTF": "objective",
         }

         def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
             self._session = session
             self._trace_repo = TraceabilityLinkRepository(session)

         async def extract_and_persist_links(
             self,
             workflow_id: UUID,
             step_name: StepName,
             package_content: dict[str, Any],
         ) -> list[TraceabilityLink]:
             """Extract trace links from package and persist using replace semantics.

             Deletes all existing links targeting this step, then inserts fresh links
             extracted from the current package. This handles package revisions correctly.

             Args:
                 workflow_id: Database workflow UUID.
                 step_name: Step name (REQUIREMENTS or OBJECTIVES).
                 package_content: Full package dict with metadata.

             Returns:
                 List of created TraceabilityLink records.

             Raises:
                 TraceabilityExtractionError: If extraction fails.
             """
             step_number = STEP_NUMBERS[step_name]

             # Step 1 has no incoming links (it's the source)
             if step_name == StepName.PROBLEM_DEFINITION:
                 return []

             # Extract link data based on step
             try:
                 if step_name == StepName.REQUIREMENTS:
                     link_data_list = self._extract_step2_links(step_number, package_content)
                 elif step_name == StepName.OBJECTIVES:
                     link_data_list = self._extract_step3_links(step_number, package_content)
                 else:
                     return []
             except Exception as e:
                 raise TraceabilityExtractionError(
                     f"Failed to extract links for {step_name.value}: {e}"
                 ) from e

             # Replace semantics: delete existing links to this step
             deleted_count = await self._trace_repo.delete_for_step(workflow_id, step_number)
             if deleted_count > 0:
                 logger.debug(f"Deleted {deleted_count} existing links to step {step_number}")

             # Insert fresh links
             created = []
             for link_data in link_data_list:
                 link = TraceabilityLink(
                     workflow_id=workflow_id,
                     from_step=link_data["from_step"],
                     from_type=link_data["from_type"],
                     from_id=link_data["from_id"],
                     to_step=link_data["to_step"],
                     to_type=link_data["to_type"],
                     to_id=link_data["to_id"],
                     link_type=link_data["link_type"],
                     consolidated=link_data.get("consolidated", False),
                 )
                 self._session.add(link)
                 created.append(link)

             if created:
                 await self._session.flush()
                 logger.info(f"Created {len(created)} trace links for step {step_number}")

             return created

         def _extract_step2_links(
             self,
             step_number: int,
             package: dict[str, Any],
         ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
             """Extract Step 1 → Step 2 links from RequirementsPackage.

             Primary source: coverage_map[] (Doc 3 §5.2)
             Each coverage_map entry maps a Step 1 element to requirement IDs.
             """
             links = []

             coverage_map = package.get("coverage_map", [])

             if not coverage_map:
                 logger.warning("RequirementsPackage has empty coverage_map; no Step 1→2 links")
                 return []

             for entry in coverage_map:
                 source_id = entry.get("source_id")
                 source_type = entry.get("source_type")
                 requirement_ids = entry.get("requirement_ids", [])

                 if not source_id or not requirement_ids:
                     continue

                 # Map source_type to canonical type
                 from_type = self._normalize_source_type(source_type)

                 for req_id in requirement_ids:
                     to_type = self._get_type_from_id(req_id)

                     links.append({
                         "from_step": 1,
                         "from_type": from_type,
                         "from_id": source_id,
                         "to_step": step_number,
                         "to_type": to_type,
                         "to_id": req_id,
                         "link_type": "derives",
                         "consolidated": False,
                     })

             return links

         def _extract_step3_links(
             self,
             step_number: int,
             package: dict[str, Any],
         ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
             """Extract Step 2 → Step 3 links from ObjectivesPackage.

             Primary source: trace_map[] (Doc 3 §5.3)
             Each trace_map entry maps an objective to requirement IDs.
             """
             links = []

             trace_map = package.get("trace_map", [])

             if not trace_map:
                 logger.warning("ObjectivesPackage has empty trace_map; no Step 2→3 links")
                 return []

             for entry in trace_map:
                 objective_id = entry.get("objective_id")
                 requirement_ids = entry.get("requirement_ids", [])
                 consolidated = entry.get("consolidated", False)

                 if not objective_id or not requirement_ids:
                     continue

                 to_type = self._get_type_from_id(objective_id)

                 for req_id in requirement_ids:
                     from_type = self._get_type_from_id(req_id)

                     links.append({
                         "from_step": 2,
                         "from_type": from_type,
                         "from_id": req_id,
                         "to_step": step_number,
                         "to_type": to_type,
                         "to_id": objective_id,
                         "link_type": "achieves",
                         "consolidated": consolidated,
                     })

             return links

         def _get_type_from_id(self, element_id: str) -> str:
             """Infer canonical element type from ID prefix."""
             if not element_id or "-" not in element_id:
                 return "unknown"

             prefix = element_id.split("-")[0]
             return self.TYPE_MAP.get(prefix, "unknown")

         def _normalize_source_type(self, source_type: str) -> str:
             """Normalize source_type string to canonical type.

             coverage_map.source_type may be: 'stakeholder', 'constraint',
             'scope', 'success_criterion', 'integration_point', etc.
             """
             if not source_type:
                 return "unknown"

             # Already canonical
             canonical_types = {
                 "stakeholder", "constraint", "scope",
                 "success_criterion", "integration_point", "assumption"
             }
             if source_type in canonical_types:
                 return source_type

             # Map variations
             type_aliases = {
                 "hard_constraint": "constraint",
                 "soft_constraint": "constraint",
                 "scope_in": "scope",
                 "scope_out": "scope",
                 "success_criteria": "success_criterion",
             }
             return type_aliases.get(source_type, source_type)

         async def get_links_for_workflow(
             self,
             workflow_id: UUID,
         ) -> list[TraceabilityLink]:
             """Get all traceability links for a workflow."""
             return await self._trace_repo.list_for_workflow(workflow_id)

         async def get_forward_traces(
             self,
             workflow_id: UUID,
             from_id: str,
         ) -> list[TraceabilityLink]:
             """Get all links originating from an element."""
             return await self._trace_repo.list_from_element(workflow_id, from_id)

         async def get_backward_traces(
             self,
             workflow_id: UUID,
             to_id: str,
         ) -> list[TraceabilityLink]:
             """Get all links pointing to an element."""
             return await self._trace_repo.list_to_element(workflow_id, to_id)

     ---
     Key Design Decisions

     | Decision                 | Choice                   | Rationale                                
                |
     |--------------------------|--------------------------|------------------------------------------
     -----------|
     | Replace semantics        | Delete + insert per step | Handles package revisions correctly; no 
     stale links |
     | Skip Step 1→3 links      | Yes                      | Doc 2 §6.1 chain directive: Step 1→2→3 
     only         |
     | coverage_map as source   | Primary for Step 1→2     | Doc 3 §5.2 designates it as traceability 
     source     |
     | trace_map as source      | Primary for Step 2→3     | Doc 3 §5.3 designates it as traceability 
     source     |
     | Canonical types          | Yes                      | Matches spec examples; simpler queries   
                |
     | Fail on extraction error | Yes                      | Surfaces Gate B violations early         
                |
     | derives for Step 1→2     | Yes                      | Requirements derive from Step 1 elements 
                |
     | achieves for Step 2→3    | Yes                      | Objectives achieve requirements          
                |

     ---
     Negative Patterns to Avoid

     | Pattern                                          | Why It's Wrong                            | 
     Correct Approach                             |
     |--------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|-
     ---------------------------------------------|
     | Insert-only idempotency                          | Leaves stale links after package revision | 
     Use replace: delete existing + insert fresh  |
     | Extract from requirements[].source               | Not the designated trace source           | 
     Use coverage_map[]                           |
     | Extract from objectives[].linked_requirements    | Not the designated trace source           | 
     Use trace_map[]                              |
     | Include Step 1→3 links (acceptance_criteria)     | Violates chain directive                  | 
     Skip - data exists in package JSON if needed |
     | Category-specific types (functional_requirement) | Not in spec model                         | 
     Use canonical types (requirement)            |
     | Continue on extraction failure                   | Hides Gate B violations                   | 
     Let errors propagate                         |
     | Store link in requirements[].trace granularity   | Too fine-grained, not authoritative       | 
     Use consolidated coverage_map view           |
     | Include tools/verify_traces.py                   | P6.2 deliverable, not P5.4                | 
     Defer to P6.2                                |
     | Implement /traceability endpoint                 | Optional for P5.4, verification tooling   | 
     Defer to P6                                  |

     ---
     Verification Commands

     # Unit tests
     PYTHONPATH=apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/unit/test_traceability_service.py -v

     # All unit tests (including P5.3)
     PYTHONPATH=apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/unit/ -v

     # Check links exist (manual verification until P6.2)
     # Run a workflow through Pass 2 Step 2+3, then query:
     # SELECT * FROM traceability_links WHERE workflow_id = '<uuid>';

     ---
     Scope Boundaries

     In Scope (P5.4):
     - TraceabilityService with link extraction from coverage_map / trace_map
     - Replace semantics (delete + insert) per step
     - Integration into workflow_service.sync_artifacts_from_state()
     - Add delete_for_step() to TraceabilityLinkRepository
     - Unit tests for extraction logic
     - Error propagation on extraction failure

     Out of Scope (Deferred):
     - GET /workflows/{id}/traceability endpoint → P6
     - tools/verify_traces.py → P6.2 (Gate B test)
     - Extraction from requirements[].source/trace (use coverage_map instead)
     - Step 1→3 links (acceptance_criteria) → not stored in traceability_links

     ---
     Exit Criterion

     P5.4 is complete when:
     1. TraceabilityService extracts links from coverage_map (Step 1→2) and trace_map (Step 2→3)
     2. Links use replace semantics (delete old, insert fresh)
     3. Links use canonical types (stakeholder, requirement, objective, etc.)
     4. Links stored in traceability_links table for approved Step 2 and Step 3 packages
     5. All unit tests pass
